user.title: TCP gateway
user.description: Enter the gateway IP or hostname. The TCP connection will be tested before scanning.

reconfigure.title: Change TCP gateway
reconfigure.description: Settings are saved only after the new TCP connection succeeds. Device and entity identities are retained.

scan_failed.title: Scan did not complete with devices
scan_failed.description: Check gateway power, wiring and slave addresses, then retry or change range.

scan_range.title: Scan range
scan_range.description: Slave IDs 1–247. Polling is paused while scanning.

scan_result.title: Manage devices
scan_result.description: Existing devices stay selected, including Missing devices. Select New devices to add; deselect devices to remove. Missing devices are never removed automatically.

model.title: Slave {slave}: model
model.description: Select the physical model. Scanning does not identify models.

groups.title: Slave {slave}: P404 outputs
groups.description: New P404 devices default to four independent dimmers. CCT uses the first register for brightness and the second for temperature.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP or hostname.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to gateway. Check the address, port and power.
